title: Let a Pod withdraw its own single-use grant request
goal: A Pod can withdraw its own pending or approved-but-unused single-use request by reference. The IdP records the terminal state withdrawn, which can no longer be approved, leaves the batch page and stops counting as pending.
summary: Add context.tools.withdraw({reference, reason}) to the Pods script runtime and a generic requester-only withdraw operation with a terminal withdrawn state to the IdP, including the broker path through pods.openape.ai. The result is withdrawn, alreadyDecided or unknown; repeats are no-ops and other Pods cannot touch the request.

problem.statement: A Pod cannot cancel a single-use request it no longer needs; only the owner can approve, deny or revoke it.
problem.impact: Mails archived by hand leave dead requests in the archive batch: approving them does nothing, they clutter the batch page and hold up o365 Shapes seeds.
problem.approach: Add a requester-only, idempotent withdraw by reference at the IdP (direct and brokered) and expose it to scripts as context.tools.withdraw with a run-history receipt.
problem.outcome: Each archive run can withdraw requests for mails that left the Inbox; the batch page shows only decisions that still matter.

context: Issue https://repos.openape.ai/patrick/monorepo/issues/1536. The Delta Mind archive Pods (Archivfreigabe c73c87de, Rechnungs-Archiv 90f456e0, Abgaben-Archiv abc817bb) call context.tools.invoke({application, argv, approvalWaitMs: 0, summary, batch, reference}) once per mail and collect the single-use grants in one IdP batch. Runtime contract 7 says terminal references are never renewed and offers no cancel. At the IdP, brokered grants can be revoked only by the human owner (requireBrokerGrantOwner); the broker protocol has the operations connection, create, authorize, get and token, but no withdraw. Code was inspected at main 2ab279bc67df9440fc43b5250f697b1836a6ce4c; the protocol at repos.openape.ai/patrick/protocol main 4287716.
scope: Protocol: terminal grant status withdrawn, requester withdraw by reference, broker operation withdraw and discovery flag openape_grant_withdraw_supported (native PR in patrick/protocol).

IdP (packages/core, packages/grants, modules/nuxt-auth-idp, apps/openape-free-idp): status, atomic transition, POST /api/grants/withdraw, broker forwarding and receiving, audit row, batch page, labels and refusal mapping.
apes CLI (packages/apes): treat HTTP 403 state withdrawn like the other terminal refusals.
Pods (apps/openape-pods): context.tools.withdraw, main-process call with the Pod identity, run-history receipt, synthetic validation, runtime reference contract 8, handbook and README.
Tests for every acceptance item of issue 1536, including the refusal paths, and one published Test Run with the actual results.
nonGoals: No change to the archive Pod scripts in this work. They follow after a Pods release and an IdP deploy, each only with the owner's OK.
No release, deployment, reseed or production data change in this session.
No withdraw of standing or unreferenced grants, no withdraw by grant ID and no withdraw by the owner or by other Pods; owner revoke stays as it is.
No renewal: a withdrawn reference stays terminal; a new operation needs a new reference.
No new Pods storage table or schema migration; the receipt is a run event.

sections.title: Code paths found
sections.body:
**Pods call path today:** `src/worker/runs/script-context.ts:28` (`tools.invoke`) → frame allowlist `scriptOperations` in `src/contracts/runs.ts:101` → dispatcher `src/worker/runs/dispatcher.ts:246-339` → `src/worker/runtime.ts` `runServices.tool` → service bridge (`src/contracts/services.ts:7` `serviceKinds`) → main `src/main/runtime-worker.ts` `executeService` (:1030) → `PodToolBroker` → ape-shell/apes with the Pod identity file → `POST /api/grants/authorize` with `reference`. Synthetic validation: `src/worker/master/validation.ts:77-117`. Runtime reference: `src/worker/master/reference.ts` (`contractVersion: 7`, pinned in `test/codex/control.test.ts:209` and `e2e/codex-acceptance.test.ts:103`). Pod access token in main: `connection.accessToken()` (`src/main/connections/agent.ts:100`). Pods grant-state validator: `src/contracts/grants.ts:11,129`.

**IdP:** `GrantStatus` in `packages/core/src/types/index.ts:95`; transitions in `packages/grants/src/grants.ts` (approve/deny need `pending`, revoke :118); stores `packages/grants/src/stores.ts` (`claimOnce` :81) and `apps/openape-free-idp/server/utils/drizzle-grant-store.ts` (`claimOnce` :214, broker pending limit counts `pending` :128/:145; `status` column has no CHECK, so no migration). Reference key `grantReferenceKey(requester, reference, brokered)` in `packages/grants/src/grant-reference.ts:23`. Program authorize refusals `modules/nuxt-auth-idp/src/runtime/server/utils/program-authorize.ts:88,188-193`. Broker forward `utils/broker-forward.ts:11` (`connection|create|authorize|get|token`); receiver `server/api/brokered-grants.post.ts`; parser `packages/grants/src/brokering.ts:62-90`; claim schema `packages/protocol-conformance/schemas/broker-request-claims.json`. Batch page `runtime/pages/grant-approval.vue` + `components/GrantBatchDecision.vue` (pending members `status:pending`, history = everything else) and `runtime/utils/grant-batch.ts`. apes refusal mapping `packages/apes/src/authorization/program.ts:94-127`.

**Shapes seed:** no code path makes `pnpm seed:shapes` (`scripts/seed-shapes.ts`) check pending grants. The plausible link is that a reseed changes the semantic adapter digest that a referenced binding contains, and a pending reference also counts against the broker pending limit. See the open question in the handoff.

milestones.title: Specify withdraw in the protocol
milestones.goal: Define the additive protocol extension before implementing it, as with grant references.
steps: In patrick/protocol (branch feature/issue-1536-grant-withdraw), add status withdrawn to grants.md §3.3 (terminal, from pending or from an approved unused once-grant) and a requester-only "Withdraw Grant by reference" operation with discovery flag openape_grant_withdraw_supported.

In grant-brokering.md §5, add operation withdraw with signed reference and optional reason; only the original binding may withdraw; brokers must not decide or withdraw for other agents. Extend the claim schema enum.
acceptance: A native protocol PR describes the state, the operation, its results and the refusal cases; the monorepo PR links it.
milestones.rollback: Close the protocol PR; nothing is deployed.

milestones.title: Terminal withdrawn state at the IdP
milestones.goal: The requester can withdraw its referenced once-grant directly or through the broker, atomically and idempotently.
steps: Add withdrawn to GrantStatus, the program-authorize 403 states, readForwardedAuthorize, the broker type unions and the Pods/apes state lists.

Add a store method that sets withdrawn only WHERE status is pending, or approved for an unused once-grant, in one statement, like claimOnce. Approve, deny, consume and token issue keep their existing pending/approved checks, so a withdrawn grant cannot be approved or consumed.

Add POST /api/grants/withdraw {reference, reason?}: an authenticated agent requester looks up its own reference key; a brokered agent at the agent provider is forwarded with broker operation withdraw; brokered-grants.post.ts resolves the key from the verified provenance, withdraws and writes a broker audit row withdrawn with the reason. Advertise openape_grant_withdraw_supported; the agent provider refuses clearly when the decision IdP lacks it.
Batch page: exclude withdrawn from both pending and history sections; grant detail and grants list label it "Withdrawn by requester" without decision buttons.
acceptance: Withdrawing a pending referenced request sets withdrawn; a later approve (single or batch operation) is refused and the request is absent from the batch page data.
Repeating the withdraw returns withdrawn with previous withdrawn and writes no second audit row.
Another requester, or the same subject under another broker binding, gets unknown and the original grant stays pending.
An approved unused once-grant becomes withdrawn and consume is refused; used, denied, revoked and expired return alreadyDecided with their state.
A withdrawn request no longer counts as pending: owner pending listing and the broker pending limit exclude it, and a repeated authorize with the same reference returns 403 state withdrawn.
milestones.rollback: Revert the IdP commits before deployment. After deployment, existing withdrawn rows stay terminal; an older IdP image would treat them as an unknown non-pending status and refuse them.

milestones.title: context.tools.withdraw in the Pods runtime
milestones.goal: Scripts withdraw their own requests through the Pod identity and get a receipt in the run history.
steps: Expose withdraw in script-context, allow tools.withdraw in scriptOperations, parse {reference, reason} next to splitScriptSummary, and route it through the service bridge as a new kind grantWithdraw to the main process.
In the main process call POST {connection.issuer}/api/grants/withdraw with the Pod access token and validate the reply strictly; append the grant-withdraw run event in the dispatcher.

Synthetic validation returns unknown; renderer labels the event; runtime reference documents withdraw and moves to contractVersion 8; update the pinned tests, handbook (EN/DE/JSON) and README; add a changeset.
acceptance: A script run that withdraws a reference returns the IdP outcome and leaves exactly one grant-withdraw event; invalid payloads are refused before any network call.
pods_control runtime reports contractVersion 8 and documents tools.withdraw.
milestones.rollback: Revert the Pods commits; scripts that call withdraw then fail with Unsupported script operation and keep their requests pending.

milestones.goal: Show the acceptance list with actual results.
steps: Run focused Vitest suites for packages/grants, modules/nuxt-auth-idp, apps/openape-free-idp, packages/apes and apps/openape-pods, then pnpm check:affected and pnpm check:ci.
Open the native PR with an explicit relation to issue 1536, update docs/agents/active-work.md, publish the Test Run under Test Runs and link it.
acceptance: pnpm check:ci passes on the PR head SHA and the Test Run lists every acceptance item with its test and result.

milestones.title: Follow-up: archive Pods withdraw stale requests
milestones.goal: After an IdP deploy and a Pods release, each archive run withdraws references whose mail left the Inbox or changed its content version.
milestones.blocker: Needs the owner's OK for the IdP deploy (both instances) and the Pods release; not part of this session.
steps: Change dm-archivfreigabe.js, dm-rechnungs-archiv.js and dm-abgaben-archiv.js (sources under ~/Companies/private/repos/openape/.claude/plans/2026-10-2*/pods/): persist each pending reference with its mail id and content version in the checkpoint; each run re-checks them and withdraws those whose mail is gone from the Inbox or changed.
acceptance: A mail archived by hand disappears from the archive batch page after the next run.

decisions.title: Withdraw by reference only
decisions.description: The reference key already binds requester and broker authority, so a Pod can only address its own requests and no grant ID needs to be trusted from a script.

decisions.title: Another Pod sees unknown
decisions.description: Requests of other identities are not addressable, so the refusal is unknown rather than forbidden; this reveals nothing about other Pods and leaves their request unchanged.

decisions.title: Receipt as run event, not effect ledger
decisions.description: Withdraw is idempotent and only removes authority. An effect-ledger entry with an unknown outcome would create a recovery hold for no benefit; a run event records the result and a lost result is safe to repeat.

decisions.title: Generic IdP, no Pod or mail logic
decisions.description: The IdP knows only requester, reference and state; deciding when to withdraw stays in the Pod script, matching the owner direction from the reference plan of 20 October.

risks.title: Race between owner approval and withdraw
risks.mitigation: Single conditional UPDATE for withdraw and the existing pending check for approve; whichever lands first wins, and a test covers approve-after-withdraw and withdraw-after-use.

risks.title: Mixed versions during rollout
risks.mitigation: Deploy the IdP (decision and agent provider) before the Pods release; the agent provider refuses withdraw when the decision IdP lacks the discovery flag, and old Pods never produce withdrawn states.

risks.title: Protocol drift
risks.mitigation: Specify the extension in a protocol PR first and keep the conformance claim schema in the monorepo in sync.

verification: Refusal paths first: approve after withdraw, consume after withdraw, other Pod withdraw, other broker binding withdraw, invalid payload.
Broker path with two IdP roles in the existing grant-brokering tests: forwarded withdraw, audit row, missing discovery flag.
Pods dispatcher, validation and control tests; pnpm check:ci on the PR head.
handoff: Revision 1 approved on 2026-10-23 and implemented in PR 506 (https://repos.openape.ai/patrick/monorepo/pulls/506) with protocol PR 9; pnpm check:ci passes on 65e46149; Test Run https://report.openape.ai/d/01M5M52S9ZX9Z576YY0QG4X3MZ?v=2. Next: owner review and merge, then IdP deploy before a Pods release, each with owner OK. Open question: what exactly blocked the o365 Shapes seed? No code check was found; the plan covers pending listings, the broker pending limit and refusing repeats of withdrawn references. If the seed procedure is a manual or scripted check elsewhere, name it and I will include it.

changelog.text: Implemented in PR 506 and protocol PR 9. Independent review found that a concurrent consume through the legacy token path could overwrite a withdrawal; fixed with conditional single-use consumption and a terminal guard. Gate and check:ci pass on 65e46149; Test Run v2 published.
Owner approved revision 1 including the protocol PR.
Revision 1 drafted from issue 1536 and code inspection at main 2ab279bc6.

entries.source: The requester can withdraw its referenced once-grant directly or through the broker, atomically and idempotently.
entries.text: Der Anfragende kann seinen referenzierten Einmal-Grant direkt oder über den Broker atomar und idempotent zurückziehen.

entries.source: Add withdrawn to GrantStatus, the program-authorize 403 states, readForwardedAuthorize, the broker type unions and the Pods/apes state lists.
entries.text: withdrawn zu GrantStatus, den 403-Zuständen von Program-Authorize, readForwardedAuthorize, den Broker-Typen und den Zustandslisten in Pods und apes hinzufügen.

entries.source: Add a store method that sets withdrawn only WHERE status is pending, or approved for an unused once-grant, in one statement, like claimOnce. Approve, deny, consume and token issue keep their existing pending/approved checks, so a withdrawn grant cannot be approved or consumed.
entries.text: Eine Store-Methode ergänzen, die withdrawn in einer einzigen Anweisung nur setzt, wenn der Status pending ist oder ein ungenutzter Einmal-Grant approved ist, wie claimOnce. Approve, Deny, Consume und Token-Ausgabe behalten ihre bestehenden pending/approved-Prüfungen, daher kann ein zurückgezogener Grant weder genehmigt noch eingelöst werden.

entries.source: Add POST /api/grants/withdraw {reference, reason?}: an authenticated agent requester looks up its own reference key; a brokered agent at the agent provider is forwarded with broker operation withdraw; brokered-grants.post.ts resolves the key from the verified provenance, withdraws and writes a broker audit row withdrawn with the reason. Advertise openape_grant_withdraw_supported; the agent provider refuses clearly when the decision IdP lacks it.
entries.text: POST /api/grants/withdraw {reference, reason?} ergänzen: Ein angemeldeter Agent sucht seinen eigenen Referenzschlüssel; ein gebrokerter Agent wird beim Agent-Provider mit der Broker-Operation withdraw weitergeleitet; brokered-grants.post.ts ermittelt den Schlüssel aus der geprüften Herkunft, zieht zurück und schreibt einen Broker-Audit-Eintrag withdrawn mit Grund. openape_grant_withdraw_supported veröffentlichen; der Agent-Provider lehnt klar ab, wenn der Entscheidungs-IdP es nicht kann.

entries.source: Batch page: exclude withdrawn from both pending and history sections; grant detail and grants list label it "Withdrawn by requester" without decision buttons.
entries.text: Batch-Seite: withdrawn aus offenen Einträgen und Verlauf ausblenden; Grant-Detail und Grant-Liste zeigen „Vom Anfragenden zurückgezogen“ ohne Entscheidungs-Buttons.

entries.source: Withdrawing a pending referenced request sets withdrawn; a later approve (single or batch operation) is refused and the request is absent from the batch page data.
entries.text: Rückzug einer offenen referenzierten Anfrage setzt withdrawn; ein späteres Genehmigen (einzeln oder per Batch-Operation) wird abgelehnt und die Anfrage fehlt in den Daten der Batch-Seite.

entries.source: Repeating the withdraw returns withdrawn with previous withdrawn and writes no second audit row.
entries.text: Ein wiederholter Rückzug liefert withdrawn mit previous withdrawn und schreibt keinen zweiten Audit-Eintrag.

entries.source: Another requester, or the same subject under another broker binding, gets unknown and the original grant stays pending.
entries.text: Ein anderer Anfragender oder dasselbe Subjekt unter einer anderen Broker-Bindung erhält unknown; der ursprüngliche Grant bleibt pending.

entries.source: An approved unused once-grant becomes withdrawn and consume is refused; used, denied, revoked and expired return alreadyDecided with their state.
entries.text: Ein genehmigter, ungenutzter Einmal-Grant wird withdrawn und Consume wird abgelehnt; used, denied, revoked und expired liefern alreadyDecided mit ihrem Zustand.

entries.source: A withdrawn request no longer counts as pending: owner pending listing and the broker pending limit exclude it, and a repeated authorize with the same reference returns 403 state withdrawn.
entries.text: Eine zurückgezogene Anfrage zählt nicht mehr als offen: Die offene Owner-Liste und das Broker-Limit schließen sie aus, und ein wiederholtes Authorize mit derselben Referenz liefert 403 mit Zustand withdrawn.

entries.source: Revert the IdP commits before deployment. After deployment, existing withdrawn rows stay terminal; an older IdP image would treat them as an unknown non-pending status and refuse them.
entries.text: IdP-Commits vor dem Deploy zurücknehmen. Nach einem Deploy bleiben vorhandene withdrawn-Zeilen endgültig; ein älteres IdP-Image behandelt sie als unbekannten, nicht offenen Status und lehnt sie ab.

entries.source: context.tools.withdraw in the Pods runtime
entries.text: context.tools.withdraw in der Pods-Runtime

entries.source: Scripts withdraw their own requests through the Pod identity and get a receipt in the run history.
entries.text: Skripte ziehen ihre eigenen Anfragen über die Pod-Identität zurück und erhalten einen Beleg in der Run-Historie.

entries.source: Expose withdraw in script-context, allow tools.withdraw in scriptOperations, parse {reference, reason} next to splitScriptSummary, and route it through the service bridge as a new kind grantWithdraw to the main process.
entries.text: withdraw im Script-Context anbieten, tools.withdraw in scriptOperations erlauben, {reference, reason} neben splitScriptSummary prüfen und als neue Art grantWithdraw über die Service-Bridge in den Hauptprozess leiten.

entries.source: In the main process call POST {connection.issuer}/api/grants/withdraw with the Pod access token and validate the reply strictly; append the grant-withdraw run event in the dispatcher.
entries.text: Im Hauptprozess POST {connection.issuer}/api/grants/withdraw mit dem Pod-Access-Token aufrufen und die Antwort streng prüfen; im Dispatcher das Run-Event grant-withdraw anhängen.

entries.source: Synthetic validation returns unknown; renderer labels the event; runtime reference documents withdraw and moves to contractVersion 8; update the pinned tests, handbook (EN/DE/JSON) and README; add a changeset.
entries.text: Synthetische Validierung liefert unknown; der Renderer beschriftet das Event; die Runtime-Referenz dokumentiert withdraw und steigt auf contractVersion 8; festgeschriebene Tests, Handbuch (EN/DE/JSON) und README anpassen; Changeset ergänzen.

entries.source: A script run that withdraws a reference returns the IdP outcome and leaves exactly one grant-withdraw event; invalid payloads are refused before any network call.
entries.text: Ein Skriptlauf, der eine Referenz zurückzieht, liefert das IdP-Ergebnis und hinterlässt genau ein grant-withdraw-Event; ungültige Nutzlasten werden vor jedem Netzwerkaufruf abgelehnt.

entries.source: pods_control runtime reports contractVersion 8 and documents tools.withdraw.
entries.text: pods_control runtime meldet contractVersion 8 und dokumentiert tools.withdraw.

entries.source: Revert the Pods commits; scripts that call withdraw then fail with Unsupported script operation and keep their requests pending.
entries.text: Pods-Commits zurücknehmen; Skripte, die withdraw aufrufen, scheitern dann mit Unsupported script operation und ihre Anfragen bleiben offen.

entries.source: Verify, open the PR and publish the Test Run
entries.text: Prüfen, PR öffnen und Test Run veröffentlichen

entries.source: Show the acceptance list with actual results.
entries.text: Die Abnahmeliste mit tatsächlichen Ergebnissen belegen.

entries.source: Run focused Vitest suites for packages/grants, modules/nuxt-auth-idp, apps/openape-free-idp, packages/apes and apps/openape-pods, then pnpm check:affected and pnpm check:ci.
entries.text: Gezielte Vitest-Suites für packages/grants, modules/nuxt-auth-idp, apps/openape-free-idp, packages/apes und apps/openape-pods ausführen, danach pnpm check:affected und pnpm check:ci.

entries.source: Open the native PR with an explicit relation to issue 1536, update docs/agents/active-work.md, publish the Test Run under Test Runs and link it.
entries.text: Nativen PR mit expliziter Beziehung zu Issue 1536 öffnen, docs/agents/active-work.md aktualisieren, Test Run unter Test Runs veröffentlichen und verlinken.

entries.source: pnpm check:ci passes on the PR head SHA and the Test Run lists every acceptance item with its test and result.
entries.text: pnpm check:ci ist auf dem PR-Head-SHA grün und der Test Run listet jeden Abnahmepunkt mit Test und Ergebnis.

entries.source: Close the PR.
entries.text: PR schließen.

entries.source: Follow-up: archive Pods withdraw stale requests
entries.text: Folgeschritt: Archiv-Pods ziehen veraltete Anfragen zurück

entries.source: After an IdP deploy and a Pods release, each archive run withdraws references whose mail left the Inbox or changed its content version.
entries.text: Nach IdP-Deploy und Pods-Release zieht jeder Archiv-Lauf Referenzen zurück, deren Mail die Inbox verlassen oder ihre Inhaltsversion geändert hat.

entries.source: Needs the owner's OK for the IdP deploy (both instances) and the Pods release; not part of this session.
entries.text: Braucht das OK des Owners für den IdP-Deploy (beide Instanzen) und das Pods-Release; nicht Teil dieser Session.

entries.source: Change dm-archivfreigabe.js, dm-rechnungs-archiv.js and dm-abgaben-archiv.js (sources under ~/Companies/private/repos/openape/.claude/plans/2026-10-2*/pods/): persist each pending reference with its mail id and content version in the checkpoint; each run re-checks them and withdraws those whose mail is gone from the Inbox or changed.
entries.text: dm-archivfreigabe.js, dm-rechnungs-archiv.js und dm-abgaben-archiv.js ändern (Quellen unter ~/Companies/private/repos/openape/.claude/plans/2026-10-2*/pods/): jede offene Referenz mit Mail-ID und Inhaltsversion im Checkpoint speichern; jeder Lauf prüft sie erneut und zieht jene zurück, deren Mail nicht mehr in der Inbox ist oder sich geändert hat.

entries.source: A mail archived by hand disappears from the archive batch page after the next run.
entries.text: Eine von Hand archivierte Mail verschwindet nach dem nächsten Lauf von der Archiv-Batch-Seite.

entries.source: Restore the previous script versions.
entries.text: Vorherige Skript-Versionen wiederherstellen.

entries.source: Withdraw by reference only
entries.text: Rückzug nur per Referenz

entries.source: The reference key already binds requester and broker authority, so a Pod can only address its own requests and no grant ID needs to be trusted from a script.
entries.text: Der Referenzschlüssel bindet Anfragenden und Broker-Berechtigung bereits; ein Pod kann so nur seine eigenen Anfragen ansprechen und keine Grant-ID aus einem Skript muss vertraut werden.

entries.source: Another Pod sees unknown
entries.text: Ein anderer Pod sieht unknown

entries.source: Requests of other identities are not addressable, so the refusal is unknown rather than forbidden; this reveals nothing about other Pods and leaves their request unchanged.
entries.text: Anfragen anderer Identitäten sind nicht adressierbar; die Ablehnung lautet daher unknown statt forbidden. Das verrät nichts über andere Pods und lässt deren Anfrage unverändert.

entries.source: Receipt as run event, not effect ledger
entries.text: Beleg als Run-Event, nicht im Effekt-Journal

entries.source: Withdraw is idempotent and only removes authority. An effect-ledger entry with an unknown outcome would create a recovery hold for no benefit; a run event records the result and a lost result is safe to repeat.
entries.text: Rückzug ist idempotent und entfernt nur Berechtigung. Ein Effekt-Journal-Eintrag mit unbekanntem Ausgang würde ohne Nutzen eine Recovery-Sperre auslösen; ein Run-Event hält das Ergebnis fest, und ein verlorenes Ergebnis darf wiederholt werden.

entries.source: Generic IdP, no Pod or mail logic
entries.text: Generischer IdP ohne Pod- oder Mail-Logik

entries.source: The IdP knows only requester, reference and state; deciding when to withdraw stays in the Pod script, matching the owner direction from the reference plan of 20 October.
entries.text: Der IdP kennt nur Anfragenden, Referenz und Zustand; wann zurückgezogen wird, entscheidet das Pod-Skript, passend zur Owner-Vorgabe aus dem Referenz-Plan vom 20. Oktober.

entries.source: Race between owner approval and withdraw
entries.text: Wettlauf zwischen Owner-Genehmigung und Rückzug

entries.source: Single conditional UPDATE for withdraw and the existing pending check for approve; whichever lands first wins, and a test covers approve-after-withdraw and withdraw-after-use.
entries.text: Ein einziges bedingtes UPDATE für den Rückzug und die bestehende pending-Prüfung für Approve; was zuerst ankommt, gewinnt. Tests decken Approve nach Rückzug und Rückzug nach Nutzung ab.

entries.source: Mixed versions during rollout
entries.text: Gemischte Versionen während des Rollouts

entries.source: Deploy the IdP (decision and agent provider) before the Pods release; the agent provider refuses withdraw when the decision IdP lacks the discovery flag, and old Pods never produce withdrawn states.
entries.text: IdP (Entscheidungs- und Agent-Provider) vor dem Pods-Release ausrollen; der Agent-Provider lehnt withdraw ab, wenn dem Entscheidungs-IdP das Discovery-Flag fehlt, und alte Pods erzeugen nie withdrawn.

entries.text: Abweichung vom Protokoll

entries.text: Die Erweiterung zuerst in einem Protokoll-PR festlegen und das Conformance-Claim-Schema im Monorepo synchron halten.

entries.source: Refusal paths first: approve after withdraw, consume after withdraw, other Pod withdraw, other broker binding withdraw, invalid payload.
entries.text: Zuerst die Ablehnungspfade: Genehmigen nach Rückzug, Einlösen nach Rückzug, Rückzug durch anderen Pod, Rückzug unter anderer Broker-Bindung, ungültige Nutzlast.

entries.source: Broker path with two IdP roles in the existing grant-brokering tests: forwarded withdraw, audit row, missing discovery flag.
entries.text: Broker-Pfad mit zwei IdP-Rollen in den bestehenden Grant-Brokering-Tests: weitergeleiteter Rückzug, Audit-Eintrag, fehlendes Discovery-Flag.

entries.text: Pods-Dispatcher-, Validierungs- und Control-Tests; pnpm check:ci auf dem PR-Head.

entries.source: Revision 1 approved on 2026-10-23 and implemented in PR 506 (https://repos.openape.ai/patrick/monorepo/pulls/506) with protocol PR 9; pnpm check:ci passes on 65e46149; Test Run https://report.openape.ai/d/01M5M52S9ZX9Z576YY0QG4X3MZ?v=2. Next: owner review and merge, then IdP deploy before a Pods release, each with owner OK. Open question: what exactly blocked the o365 Shapes seed? No code check was found; the plan covers pending listings, the broker pending limit and refusing repeats of withdrawn references. If the seed procedure is a manual or scripted check elsewhere, name it and I will include it.
entries.text: Revision 1 am 2026-10-23 freigegeben und in PR 506 (https://repos.openape.ai/patrick/monorepo/pulls/506) mit Protokoll-PR 9 umgesetzt; pnpm check:ci ist auf 65e46149 grün; Test Run https://report.openape.ai/d/01M5M52S9ZX9Z576YY0QG4X3MZ?v=2. Nächster Schritt: Review und Merge durch den Owner, dann IdP-Deploy vor einem Pods-Release, jeweils mit OK des Owners. Offene Frage: Was genau hat den o365-Shapes-Seed blockiert? Ich habe keine Prüfung im Code gefunden; der Plan deckt offene Listen, das Broker-Limit und die Ablehnung wiederholter zurückgezogener Referenzen ab. Falls der Seed-Ablauf woanders manuell oder per Skript prüft, bitte nennen, dann nehme ich ihn auf.

entries.source: Implemented in PR 506 and protocol PR 9. Independent review found that a concurrent consume through the legacy token path could overwrite a withdrawal; fixed with conditional single-use consumption and a terminal guard. Gate and check:ci pass on 65e46149; Test Run v2 published.
entries.text: In PR 506 und Protokoll-PR 9 umgesetzt. Ein unabhängiges Review fand, dass ein gleichzeitiges Consume über den älteren Token-Pfad einen Rückzug überschreiben konnte; behoben durch bedingten Einmal-Verbrauch und eine Endzustands-Sperre. Gate und check:ci sind auf 65e46149 grün; Test Run v2 veröffentlicht.
